identified_issues: Auditor conflated the post-execution completion log (EMS_LOG_9941) with pre-switching authorization (SO-2026-8812).
Epistemic category error: treating the requirement for prior authorization as requiring post-execution event logging to precede physical breaker opening, which is physically and logically impossible.
evidence: Switching Order SO-2026-8812 was submitted at 2026-10-06T15:45:00.000Z and formally approved with status APPROVED_PRE_AUTHORIZED at 2026-10-06T15:50:00.000Z, twenty minutes prior to physical breaker actuation.
Physical actuation occurred at 2026-10-06T16:10:02.145Z, strictly within the pre-authorized window of 2026-10-06T16:00:00Z to 2026-10-06T17:00:00Z.
Relay SEL_451 sequence-of-events log confirms manual actuation directly referenced approved order SO-2026-8812.

Execution completion log EMS_LOG_9941 was entered into DISPATCH_EMS at 2026-10-06T16:12:15.000Z (2 minutes 13 seconds post-actuation), satisfying Regional Grid Operating Standard Section 4.2 requiring completion logging within 15 minutes.
recommended_action: Dismiss the auditor infraction notice; validate the switching operation as fully compliant with Regional Grid Operating Standard Section 4.2; update compliance audit rules to distinguish pre-authorization timestamps from post-execution logging confirmation timestamps.
